primary_evidence: Completed 4D Opus xHigh/16384 development pilots01–05 only; source/scope filters apply to every outcome. Original files remain immutable.
secondary_evidence: Older 6000 Opus High/4096 development tasks are a separate lower-fidelity training/transfer comparison, never pooled as equal-fidelity accuracy evidence.
source_precautions: Current shared policy14, existing pilot04 local source exclusions, unresolved urja code10.0023 omitted uniformly, and Karmani restricted to the preexisting exact transitive-meaning allowlist. Passing these screens is not exhaustive source certification.
features: Visible gana and the four inflection coordinates, each categorical
Citation accent/nasal markers and literal-final-a status, coarse citation length
Initial lexical it-deletion base only: coarse length, vowel count, initial/final phoneme class, consonant clusters, penultimate-vowel class, presence of r/v
Individual numeric grammar rule IDs in the oracle trace union; no surface answer, gold-variant count, model reasoning or model answer used as a predictor
family_separation: Group by the initial lexical phonemic base after it deletion, merging ganas and visible marker variants where the base agrees. Hash each group into five folds. This is stricter than exact master-family separation; all rows remain in master development.
models: Previously known adanta Curadi indicator baseline
Best interpretable single-feature rule or two-feature conjunction, selected only within training folds
rule_fit: At least20 training rows and8 distinct broad lexical groups on each side, with at least2 error groups inside the proposed harder rule. Choose maximal family-weighted Bernoulli likelihood improvement; predictions use fixed Beta(1,19) shrinkage. No hyperparameter search. Include feature-only and feature-plus-trace variants.
validation: Every validation family is absent from fitting, feature-support screening and rule selection. Secondary historical transfer fitting also removes all rows from the validation lexical groups. All observations are retrospective: previous human access and adaptive pilot selection prevent claiming prospective or population-unbiased validation.
reported_metrics: family-weighted Brier score and log loss
accuracy and error-family count in the predeclared top20percent ranked slice
family bootstrap interval for that slice
all seeds and all easy results
residual_analysis: Repeat after excluding all dictionary adanta Curadi families, so rediscovery of the known narrow lead is not presented as a new mechanism.
advance_gate: Only propose a fresh paid pilot if a distinct interpretable mechanism has current-reference out-of-family support, at least5 source-supported error families overall, at least3 ganas represented, and an independently plausible source/supply audit. These are conservative diagnostic gates, not user-mandated final diversity quotas. Sparse residual labels or unstable rankings support a no-pilot finding, not an impossibility claim.
outputs: Versioned diagnostic data, fold manifest, readable findings and either a fresh grammar-defined pilot request or explicit no-paid-pilot rationale. No final question membership is selected.
